description: Create a payment and get a hosted checkout_url to send to the customer (Wave or Orange Money). The payment is NOT paid until its status is 'succeeded' — check with xaalis_get_payment or a signed webhook, never the customer's redirect.

amount.description: Amount the customer pays, in whole XOF (F CFA). Integer, no decimals: 5000 = 5 000 F CFA.

idempotency_key.description: Stable key for this business action (e.g. order-1042). Reuse the SAME key when retrying; a new key creates a new operation.

provider.description: Skip the method picker and start this provider directly

name: xaalis_create_payment
title: Create a payment (checkout link)
